text:
Situation: FDA first posted the carboplatin shortage on 2023-04-28 and it remains Current as of 2026-10-21. Corvale Lakeside holds 1.5 days of 60 mL vials and 2.5 days of 5 mL vials. Corvale East holds 15.1 days of 60 mL vials and 20.6 days of 5 mL vials. Corvale General holds approximately 9 days across three lots.

Why (FDA record): The Accord Healthcare product on the shortage list is manufactured by Intas Pharmaceuticals Limited, which received an OAI classification letter dated 2023-04-05. The OAI inspection ended 2022-12-02 and cited 11 observations including absence of written procedures and sterile drug product controls. An import alert for Intas was published 2023-06-01 and a Warning Letter issued 2023-07-28, both after the shortage posting.

Our position: Corvale East and Corvale Lakeside use Teva Parenteral Medicines product labeled from PHARMACHEMIE BV, which is not the OAI plant. The rule‑ranked best option is to transfer 3 vials of 10 mg/mL, 60 mL from Corvale East to Corvale Lakeside.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 3 vials of 10 mg/mL, 60 mL from Corvale East to Corvale Lakeside — approved by pharmacy director (transfer request).
2. Transfer 10 vials of 10 mg/mL, 5 mL from Corvale East to Corvale Lakeside — approved by pharmacy director (transfer request).
3. Transfer 14 vials of 10 mg/mL, 5 mL from Corvale East to Corvale General — approved by pharmacy director (transfer request).
4. Use Teva Parenteral Medicines, Inc. 10 mg/mL product — approved by pharmacist (Casey Nguyen, MD approved 2026-01-18).
5. Use Apotex Corp. 10 mg/mL product — approved by pharmacist (Alex Morgan, PharmD approved 2026-05-16).

Not recommended: No additional actions at this time.
